title: Generic resource graph migration wave 1
goal: Make selected simple bespoke machinen move envelopes generic-primary or generic-equivalent through genericResourceGraphState while preserving bespoke fallback, exact refusal evidence, target evidence, and honest non-claims.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the migration candidates are explicitly selected and scoped: python-http, python-http-directory, nc-listener, reader-cat, grep, and tail are evaluated, with tail migrated only if offset/follow semantics are preserved or otherwise kept as bespoke fallback with an honest generic refusal/equivalence boundary.
proofChecklist.evidence: Explicitly scoped the six wave-1 migration candidates in docs/snapshot/generic-resource-graph-migration-wave1.md and docs/snapshot/generic-resource-graph-inventory.json. stopIf: A migration would remove or lower-priority a bespoke loader before equivalent generic happy-path and refusal evidence exists.
Tail offset/follow semantics cannot be represented generically without weakening correctness; in that case tail must remain bespoke fallback or be explicitly refused for generic migration.
A candidate depends on unsupported pipes, PTYs, active sockets, runtime state, source-ISA emulation, or metadata-only acceptance.
The implementation would claim arbitrary process, any-binary, arbitrary shell pipeline, or process teleportation instead of selected resource-class migration.
Required local proof tooling or VMM assets are unavailable for the targeted matrix rows.
Required validation fails and cannot be fixed within the migration scope.
The /goal loop reaches 8 agent completion(s) without satisfying the contract.
